## Summary

Addresses the two open PRs with the most unresolved review threads (PR #124 with 10 and PR #123 with 6), integrating both sets of changes with all reviewer feedback applied.

### PR #124 — Extract +page.svelte script into StudioState runes class (10 threads)

- **`src/routes/studio-state.svelte.ts`** (new): The full 690-line StudioState class with every seam/adapter call passing `$state.snapshot()` — `this.spec`, `this.voice`, `this.textOutput` — so reactive proxies never escape the component boundary
- **`saveToVault`**: guarded `studioText` with `this.textOutput ? $state.snapshot(this.textOutput) : undefined`; catch block prevents `localStorage` quota errors from leaving `vaultStatus` stuck
- **`validateSpec`**: passes `$state.snapshot(this.spec)` to the spec validation adapter
- **`saveDraft`**: passes `$state.snapshot(this.spec)` and `$state.snapshot(this.textOutput)`
- **`runTextAction`**: validation/early-return before `isTextWorking = true`; `$state.snapshot(this.voice)` in the API payload
- **`weeklyModes` / `monthlyModeId`**: computed per-instance via `getWeeklyModes()` / `getMonthlyMode()` (not frozen at module load), so a long-lived SSR process sees the correct week/month rotation after mount
- **`src/routes/+page.svelte`**: replaced the 1 444-line monolith with a 100-line thin wrapper that delegates all logic to `StudioState`

**Deferred (architectural — too large for this PR):** The chatgpt-codex-connector P1 thread notes that `postJson` calls in `StudioState` bypass the seam layer. Addressing this requires new seams for `meechie-studio-text` and `wig-try-on` endpoints; tracked as a follow-on task.

### PR #123 — Four quick wins + ESLint globals (6 threads)

- **`chat-interpretation.adapter.ts`**: always parse body first (the route returns a structured `Result` even on 4xx/5xx); use `CHAT_HTTP_ERROR` with `details.status` / `details.statusText` for non-2xx; only fall back to `CHAT_NETWORK_ERROR` on a network exception — addresses threads from chatgpt-codex-connector, copilot, and CodeRabbit
- **`eslint.config.js`**: added `globals.browser` for Svelte files; `globals.node + fetch` for probe scripts; kept the core `no-unused-vars` rule with `argsIgnorePattern`/`varsIgnorePattern` (CodeRabbit's review correctly flags that switching to `@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars` would not help for TS type-alias parameter names — Gemini's suggestion was incorrect)
- **Six component callback type signatures** (`SelfieUpload`, `WigCarousel`, `StudioHero`, `StudioInputPanel`, `VerdictRow`, `WigTryOnStudio`): prefixed unused type-annotation parameter names with `_`
- **`probes/provider-adapter.probe.mjs`**: optional catch binding (`catch {}`)
- **`StudioInputPanel`**: removed the unused `textOutput` prop (was declared and destructured but never rendered in the template)

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run lint` — 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run check` — 0 errors
- [ ] `npm test` — all pass
- [ ] Studio page loads and all actions (generate text, generate page, wig try-on, save to vault) work end-to-end

## Summary by Sourcery

Extract Meechie Studio page logic into a reusable Svelte runes state class and address outstanding review feedback on chat interpretation, linting, and callback typing.

New Features:
- Introduce a StudioState Svelte runes class encapsulating all Meechie Studio page state, actions, and lifecycle for reuse and easier testing.

Bug Fixes:
- Ensure weekly and monthly studio modes are computed per instance so long-lived processes see current rotations.
- Guard studio draft and vault persistence with safer error handling and snapshotting of reactive state to avoid leaking proxies outside the component.
- Improve chat interpretation error handling by parsing structured error bodies on non-2xx responses and distinguishing HTTP errors from network failures.

Enhancements:
- Refactor the studio +page.svelte component into a thin wrapper that delegates all behavior to the StudioState class.
- Normalize wig try-on and coloring page generation flows through centralized helper methods and derived state in StudioState.
- Mark unused callback parameters with underscore-prefixed names to suppress ESLint unused-variable warnings without altering behavior.

Build:
- Update ESLint flat config to define browser and Node globals appropriately and configure no-unused-vars ignore patterns for conventionally unused parameters.

Chores:
- Relax probe JSON parsing to use optional catch bindings for cleaner error handling.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the Meechie Studio page by extracting its state logic from `+page.svelte` into a dedicated Svelte 5 runes state class, `StudioState`, in `studio-state.svelte.ts`.
